g.text: Title: MCU, programming header & front-panel link

g.text: Thermomix TM31-4C (120 V) power board NPVTM31LTA-3

g.desc: Thermomix TM31-4C (120 V) power board NPVTM31LTA-3

g.text: Traced from a working board by continuity tests; see notes for confidence levels

g.desc: Traced from a working board by continuity tests; see notes for confidence levels

g.text: - MCU pin numbers per the datasheet QFP drawing (p.6), marking D78F0034BCC (archived datasheet in datasheets/archive/).

g.desc: - MCU pin numbers per the datasheet QFP drawing (p.6), marking D78F0034BCC (archived datasheet in datasheets/archive/).

g.text: - UART0: PC502 carries panel -> MCU RxD0 (pin 21); PC501 carries MCU TxD0 (pin 22) -> panel. PC503 (LED driven by the panel on pins 5/1) pulls ARM low = arms watchdog timer 1.

g.desc: - UART0: PC502 carries panel -> MCU RxD0 (pin 21); PC501 carries MCU TxD0 (pin 22) -> panel. PC503 (LED driven by the panel on pins 5/1) pulls ARM low = arms watchdog timer 1.

g.text: - APPROXIMATE on the cold side: Q506's exact role, LED polarities of PC501/PC503, resistor values RX40-RX42; R540 not drawn.

g.desc: - APPROXIMATE on the cold side: Q506's exact role, LED polarities of PC501/PC503, resistor values RX40-RX42; R540 not drawn.

g.text: - Never connect a mains-earthed adapter to the hot side. To sniff the link, use the COLD side of CN300 only (see docs/15-future-work.md).

g.desc: - Never connect a mains-earthed adapter to the hot side. To sniff the link, use the COLD side of CN300 only (see docs/15-future-work.md).

g.text: 1 GND_COLD 2 data from panel 3 VCOLD 4 data to panel 5 panel enable

g.desc: 1 GND_COLD 2 data from panel 3 VCOLD 4 data to panel 5 panel enable
